subject: Penpot export breakpoint 02 — plugin connected
body: Run the deterministic Penpot export probe now that the Penpot MCP plugin visibly shows Connected. Do not use LLM tool planning. Call export_shape on shapeId page with format png, capture direct result and filePath fallback diagnostics, and report image_count, visual_source, visual_fallback_error, result_content_types, and visual_diagnostics. Also surface any Penpot/MCP version mismatch error text verbatim in diagnostics. Do not mutate the design.
